name: services/surveys/surveys

arguments.name: survey_ids
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of survey IDs, as described in survey method.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section of survey method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary that will map your survey_ids to survey objects, as defined in the survey method.

deprecated.reason:
This method does not support some surveys (e.g. surveys with open questions) and
will treat them as non-existent.
